Anant Singh Daughter Tilak: mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh ki rasmen shuru ho gaee hain. is khas mauke par parivar ke sadasyon aur rishtedaron ki maujudgi men shadi ki rasmen nibhaee ja rahi hain. samaroh men shivangi ki man aur purv vidhayak nilam devi bhi maujud rahin.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
